title: Patch: revisit the AI's Burn and Toxic weights after the Stinkyscape+ sweep

**Issue #5006 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #5006: Patch: revisit the AI's Burn and Toxic weights after the Stinkyscape+ sweep
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A unit or hero with Burn or Toxic counters still to come is worth less in the AI's eyes: half a point of value per point of damage on the way, over the next four turn starts. Those halves were starting guesses, left with a note to revisit after fullsend 2's Stinkyscape+ sweep, and the sweep has since run and cleared while the guesses never moved. Once built, the AI prices burning and poisoned boards at what 400 paired games say they are worth instead of at the guess. A player meets it as a practice opponent that values attrition boards more sanely, for example paying the measured price, when it trades or walls, for a unit that will take a Toxic tick, instead of the guessed half.

## Why

- [config.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/src/config.rs) (R3822000) calls `unit_affliction`, `unit_doomed` and `hero_affliction` (0.5 each) `untuned starts, to revisit after #3574's sweep`. The sweep ran ([sweep-2026-11-13.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/history/sweep-2026-11-13.md), R3574000) and neither the comment nor any open or recent issue records the revisit.
- The smoke gate cannot distinguish the guess from zero: 20, 18 and 18 of 20 at 0.5 against 19, 18 and 18 at 0, all above the 19/14/15 floors. [SPEC §9.9](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md) says a gate of this size catches a broken AI, not a lost point or two, and a claim about strength needs hundreds of fresh deals, not the gate.
- Burn and Toxic are live Stinkyscape+ mechanics the AI meets in practice: Noxious Rounds (Toxic), Volcanic Rounds (Burn since #4783, R4783001), and the Force Projector and Oct damage pools (R4064000), read over `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` (4) turn starts.
- `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps all three weights at 0 as the frozen yardstick the gates were fixed on; the change must leave it there.

## Proposal

- One deal screen exactly as [training/improve.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/improve.md) (A screen) prescribes: build a control from the tip, then screen `unit_affliction` at 1.0 against the 0.5 control with `unit_doomed` and `hero_affliction` held (one change, size fixed in advance: 400 games on improve-dev). Keep it only if `edgeLow` is above 0, otherwise revert per R4319000, and record the tally (control commit, edge, decided wonBoth/lostBoth, diverged) in the `AI_EVAL` comment.
- Hold the kept value with extended scenes in [affliction_threat.rs](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs) that fail without it; never weaken an existing scene. Leave `GREEDY_EVAL` at 0. Re-record the practice-claim fixture with the change ([training/README.md](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/training/README.md), The practice-claim fixture), since decisions change.
- If the screen is inconclusive, close it out with the screen recorded; a different arm (for example 0.25) is a separate future screen, never a re-read of this one.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs`: the `AI_EVAL` affliction trio only.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs`: scenes pinning the kept value.
- `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json`: re-recorded with the change.
- No spec change (a number, not a rule) and no ruling; [SPEC §9.9](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md)'s evaluation paragraph already describes the ticks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deal screen run on improve-dev with its control commit and tally recorded in the config comment.
- [ ] Kept value has `edgeLow` above 0, or the knob is reverted with the inconclusive screen recorded.
- [ ] New or extended `affliction_threat.rs` scenes fail without the kept value.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` are green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) still clears its floors.
- [ ] The practice-claim fixture is re-recorded with the change and its tests pass.

## Size and risks

Medium work, difficulty hard (AI tuning). The bulk is one 400-game deal screen, about 25 to 45 minutes on two cores per improve.md, plus config and scene tests. Main risk is an inconclusive screen, which most tuning screens are; then the change is reverted per R4319000 and only the recorded screen and any kept scenes remain. No design call, no gate or yardstick change.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/45758679180)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Screen `AI_EVAL.unit_affliction` at 1.0 against the 0.5 control with one 400-game deal screen on improve-dev, keeping 1.0 only when `edgeLow` is above 0 and otherwise reverting per R4319000. Either way the config comment records the screen tally, new scenes in `affliction_threat.rs` pin the kept value, `GREEDY_EVAL` stays at 0, and the practice-claim fixture is re-recorded with the change.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AI_EVAL.unit_affliction`: 0.5 → 1.0 if the screen keeps it; rewrite the R3822000 comment (lines ~846-849) with the screen tally. `unit_doomed`, `hero_affliction`, `AI_AFFLICTION_TICKS` untouched |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs` | change | New scene tests pinning the kept value against a 0.5 control const; existing tests untouched |
| `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json` | change | Re-recorded with the kept value via the claim test's record mode |

Must not touch: `GREEDY_EVAL` (frozen yardstick, stays 0 on all three weights), `AI_BUDGET` / `AI_GATE_BUDGET`, anything in `crates/engine`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. No spec change (a number, not a rule) and no ruling note: [§9.9](spec/09-architecture/9.9-practice-ai.md)'s evaluation paragraph already describes the ticks. Governing spec: §9.9 evaluation paragraph; rulings cited in code: R3822000 (the weights), R4319000 (screen keep/revert rule), R3574000 (the sweep).

## Steps

1. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, read the R3822000 comment above `unit_affliction` (lines ~846-849) and the `AI_EVAL` literal (lines ~850-852). Build the control from the committed tip first, before any edit: `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp target/release/jackioh ~/control-jackioh` (training/improve.md, A screen, step 1).
2. Make the single change: set `AI_EVAL.unit_affliction` from `0.5` to `1.0`. Leave `unit_doomed` and `hero_affliction` at `0.5`, and leave every field of `GREEDY_EVAL` (lines ~1085-1087) at `0.0`.
3. Screen it against the control with exactly: `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:~/control-jackioh --set improve-dev` (400 paired games, ~25-45 min on two cores; fixed size decided in advance, never extended on a near-miss). Keep 1.0 only when the tally's `edgeLow` is above 0; otherwise revert the literal to `0.5` per R4319000. An `inconclusive: true` tally (fewer than `SCREEN_MIN_DECIDED` decided deals) neither keeps nor drops the knob by itself: revert the literal and let the scene tests settle it, as the `strike_back_survival_read` and `splash_trample_read` comments show.
4. Record the screen in the R3822000 comment in the established tally form, e.g. `#5006: at 1.0, 400 games on improve-dev against the control at <tip-sha>, read 214-186, edge +0.070 (+0.012 to +0.128), 12 decided (won 8, lost 4), 40 diverged: kept` (or `: reverted`, with `inconclusive (R4319000)` and decided counts when inconclusive). Keep the existing smoke-gate sentence only if still true; otherwise replace it with the new screen record.
5. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs`, add a control const after the existing `OFF` const (lines ~24-28), copying its pattern: `const HALF: EvalWeights = EvalWeights { unit_affliction: 0.5, ..AI_EVAL };`. This is the 0.5 guess the screen ran against.
6. Add scene tests with plain descriptive names (no `r<N>` prefix; ruling-style names are only for ruling proofs — follow `evasive.rs`, e.g. `an_evasive_attackers_even_trade_waits_behind_the_plays`). Suggested scenes using the file's existing helpers (`lethal`, `walls`, `close`, `face_threat_with`, `evaluate`, `NextSwing`): (a) a Toxic-ticked enemy unit whose discounted worth at 1.0 flips a `close(...)` ordering or a wall/stand-down decision versus `HALF` — e.g. extend the `lethal` board so the 7/7 walls under `AI_EVAL` but not under `HALF`, or an `evaluate` gap assertion like line ~105-108 that holds only at 1.0; (b) a trade/wall choice where the seat takes the Toxic tick at 1.0 but trades into it at 0.5. Each new test must pass with `AI_EVAL` at 1.0 and fail with `HALF` in place of `AI_EVAL` (assert both directions in the test body where cheap). Never weaken an existing scene.
7. Re-record the practice-claim fixture: `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, then `JACKIOH_RECORD_PRACTICE_CLAIM=1 pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts`, and commit the rewritten `crates/server/tests/fixtures/practice-claim.json` with the change (training/README.md, The practice-claim fixture).
8. Run the proof: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit` (runs the `affliction_threat` and `evaluate` suites), `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/practice/claim.test.ts`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server practice` (covers `r1303002_r2560000_the_game_the_worker_played_folds_and_pays`), and `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke floors).

## Tests

- `crates/ai/tests/ai/affliction_threat.rs`: new scene tests (descriptive names, e.g. `a_toxic_tick_priced_at_the_measured_weight_walls_the_lethal`), each asserting the AI's read under `AI_EVAL` (1.0) and the opposite read under the `HALF` (0.5) const, so each fails if the knob is reverted. Run: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit --test ai affliction_threat`.
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/evaluate.rs`: existing R3822000 tests (e.g. `r3822000_a_unit_its_next_tick_kills_is_worth_less_than_the_same_unit_without_the_counter`) must keep passing — they read `AI_EVAL.unit_affliction` symbolically, so they hold at any value; run: `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit --test ai r3822000`.
- `apps/web/src/practice/claim.test.ts`: re-record then pass: `JACKIOH_RECORD_PRACTICE_CLAIM=1 pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/practice/claim.test.ts` once, then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/practice/claim.test.ts`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs` `r1303002_r2560000_the_game_the_worker_played_folds_and_pays`: folds the re-recorded fixture; run: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server practice`.
- `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke): must still clear its floors; the issue notes the guess read 20, 18, 18 of 20 at 0.5 against floors, so a kept 1.0 must not drop below them.

## Done when

- [ ] Deal screen run on improve-dev (400 games, control commit recorded in the config comment with edge, wonBoth/lostBoth, diverged).
- [ ] Kept value has `edgeLow` above 0, or the knob is reverted to 0.5 with the inconclusive screen recorded.
- [ ] New `affliction_threat.rs` scenes fail with the knob at 0.5 and pass at the kept value; no existing scene weakened.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL` still reads 0 on all three affliction weights.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --features testkit`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` green.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) clears its floors.
- [ ] Practice-claim fixture re-recorded with the change and its web + server tests pass.
- [ ] Each decision the task left open recorded with the rejected alternative (improve.md forbids second reads and best-of-arm keeping: one arm, one screen).

## Risks

- Inconclusive screen (most likely: tuning screens usually are): then revert the literal per R4319000, keep the recorded screen and any kept scenes. Do not screen 0.25 or any other arm — that is a separate future screen, never a re-read.
- Scene tests that pass at both 0.5 and 1.0 prove nothing: each must be checked against the `HALF` const, not just `AI_EVAL`, before counting it as pinning.
- Engine-purity lints: test files stay pure (no clock/I/O); the arena screen is the only long step and runs outside the test suites.
- Practice-claim drift: any AI change replays the fixture differently, so re-record only after the final keep/revert decision, then run both the web claim test and the server fold-and-pay test.

## Open questions

None. The proposal, size (400 games fixed in advance), keep rule (`edgeLow` > 0), fallback (revert per R4319000), and landing spots are all settled by the issue and training/improve.md.
```
